belongs_to_collection.name: Three Hundred at the Pass Collection

data.overview: When a vast Persian army advances through Greece, the king of a small city-state leads a handful of warriors to defend a narrow mountain pass. Against impossible odds, their stand becomes a legend of defiance, sacrifice, and the price of glory.
data.title: Three Hundred at the Pass
